% note: Each cell's stamped bootstrap interval has zero width, because every puzzle in it was right, or every one wrong (the count right out of the cell's puzzles says which); the exact interval replaces it. Agreement thirds split a bin's puzzles by how often their wrong samples repeat each other, lowest first; ``too few wrong samples'' holds the puzzles with too few wrong samples to be placed in a third.
% note: Labels: each stamped interval keeps the plan's label for ⟦FIG-02⟧, which draws it (the main analysis stamps no label for item~20): pre-specified descriptive; no test, no cause; the counts and the exact intervals are post hoc presentation. Samples per puzzle: 40 (the vote's $k$); a puzzle counts once in the count of puzzles right.
